jobs.title: Operations Project Manager
jobs.description:
Carelancer is a growing Canadian healthcare technology company connecting families with independent care providers through our digital platform. As we expand into the U.S. market, we’re looking for an experienced, proactive Operations Project Manager with a strong background in digital business operations and software development coordination.
Working directly with the Founder and CEO, you’ll take ownership of key projects, coordinate our established team of senior developers and external partners, and build practical systems that help the business run efficiently.

Our developers own technical investigation, estimates, solutions, and implementation. Your responsibility is to clarify business priorities, establish ownership and deadlines, coordinate delivery, and ensure agreed outcomes are achieved. Your core priorities will be software development coordination and operational execution. Process improvements, automation, and additional projects will be planned according to business priorities and available capacity. This is a hands-on role for someone who takes initiative, brings forward recommendations, and follows through without constant oversight.

Employment Details

Employment type:
Full-time, permanent.
Work location:
Remote.
Schedule:
Monday to Friday, minimum 40 hours per week.
Compensation:
Annual salary based on experience and qualifications.

Key Responsibilities

Project Management and Execution

Manage projects from initial planning through implementation and verification.
Define scope, priorities, timelines, deliverables, and responsibilities.
Coordinate internal teams, contractors, and external partners.
Maintain clear project plans, dashboards, and progress reports.
Identify dependencies, bottlenecks, and risks early, and coordinate action to keep projects moving.
Give the CEO concise updates on progress, risks, recommendations, and decisions requiring approval.
Flag competing priorities and capacity constraints so workloads and commitments remain realistic.

Problem Solving and Accountability

Clarify issues as they arise: what is happening, what is affected, and how urgently action is needed.
Establish who is responsible for investigating each issue and proposing solutions.
Set deadlines for the team to return with findings and recommendations.
Work with the appropriate specialists to assess trade-offs in cost, development time, quality, and release impact.
Bring forward a recommendation informed by specialist input, identify who needs to approve it, and move the decision forward.
Track implementation and verify with the relevant team that the issue has been resolved.
Exercise independent judgment within your responsibilities and escalate issues with relevant context and a recommendation.

Software Development Coordination

Coordinate platform development, new features, improvements, and bug fixes with senior developers and technical partners.
Coordinate planning for development and releases.
Ensure blockers have an owner, a next step, and a deadline.
Coordinate business testing and confirm that completed work meets agreed business requirements.
Keep technical teams and business stakeholders aligned on priorities, dependencies, and expected outcomes.

Digital Business Operations

Manage operational coordination, communications, and follow-ups for assigned initiatives across technology, marketing, business development, and other functions.
Develop and document workflows that establish clear responsibilities and reduce missed commitments.
Identify inefficiencies and implement practical improvements suited to a small, growing team.
Resolve routine operational issues within your responsibilities and coordinate matters requiring specialist input or leadership approval.
Support agreed operational projects related to Carelancer’s growth and U.S. expansion.

AI, Automation, and Digital Productivity

Use AI tools such as ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, or Claude to support research, reporting, documentation, and project execution.
Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks, communications, and reporting, and implement improvements according to priorities and capacity.
Improve collaboration and project visibility through appropriate digital tools.
Verify AI-generated work and handle confidential business information and sensitive data responsibly.

Additional Projects

Coordinate selected marketing, video, and content projects as priorities and capacity allow.
Manage scheduling, timelines, production logistics, and follow-ups, with the relevant specialists responsible for content and production.
Support other agreed business initiatives while maintaining visibility on their impact on core project commitments.

Required Qualifications

5+ years of relevant experience
in project management, digital business operations, or a combination of both.
Proven experience working directly with software developers
and coordinating software projects through development, testing, and release.
Experience within a digital business, SaaS company, online marketplace, or technology-driven organization.
A strong working understanding of software development workflows.
Ability to work with technical teams to turn business requirements into clear tasks, define completion criteria, and verify business outcomes.
Demonstrated ability to coordinate investigations, recommend action, and follow through.
Experience managing competing priorities and delivering projects independently.
Experience improving operational systems and workflows.
Advanced proficiency in Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Teams.
Experience with tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, Microsoft Planner, Microsoft Project, ClickUp, Asana, or similar platforms.
Practical experience using AI and automation to improve business processes.
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and sound judgment.
Experience coordinating remote teams, contractors, and external partners.

*Coding experience is not required. A strong understanding of software development processes and the ability to communicate confidently with developers are essential.

Who Will Thrive in This Role

You take ownership from the moment a priority is identified until the outcome is verified. You ask thoughtful questions, establish clear responsibilities, and address missed commitments constructively. You’re comfortable working with senior technical specialists, asking for clear estimates and recommendations, and ensuring decisions lead to action.

Overview

Resonetics is a global leader in advanced engineering, prototyping, product development, and micro manufacturing, driving innovation in the medical device industry. With rapid expansion across all our locations, we continue to push the boundaries of technology while fostering a dynamic, employee-centered culture. Our commitment to excellence and continuous improvement makes Resonetics an exciting place for professionals passionate about shaping the future of micro-manufacturing and being part of something bigger.

The Program Manager at Resonetics is a key leader who manages multi-site programs involving vertically integrated technologies, processes, and businesses. Reporting to the Director of Program Management Office, t he Program Manager will work and drive production implementation of new products and technologies that originate within Resonetics Light Speed Lab group as well as other “transfer-in opportunities ”. They oversee all activities supporting and serving strategic customers and their portfolio of new and existing products.

Typical programs involve multiple Resonetics design and manufacturing locations, complex supply chain networks, and working with site Directors of Operations, development core teams, commercial and business development leaders, procurement, and other operations functions .

Join Resonetics and be part of a team that’s redefining medical device manufacturing. If you’re passionate about innovation and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we’d love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

Serves as the principal contact with external customers. Coordinates and directs customer meetings and visits, and day-to-day customer communication , drive escalation/resolution of technical efforts as warranted .
Manages internal resources through dotted line relationships to meet program goals and milestones. Works with internal management to ensure appropriate resources have been assigned.
Assists business development team with definition of program scope, timeline, and budget to support preparation of proposals, quotations, and change orders for customers.
Work closely with internal global cross-functional engineering teams and subject matter experts as well as external technical partners to plan and develop project scope, deliverables, required resources, detailed work breakdown structure, project budget, costing analysis, risk mitigation plans and project timing.
Regularly publish progress status reports to leadership and stakeholders highlighting achievements, milestone deliveries and associated metrics.
Proactively communicate escalations around challenges, gaps, support required and resource needs to quickly address issues before they impede successful delivery of the program.
Keep projects on track and ensure timely completion within the defined scope, accountable for successfully meeting or exceeding commitments on product performance, product cost, cycle time, project cost and quality.
Generate high-level plans, communications, and schedules to assist with task prioritization and workload adjustments.
Identifies potential project risks and develops/ implements strategies to minimize impact and control deviations from estimated costs and project deadlines.
Proactively communicates project schedules, project change proposals and related project activities on a regular basis with customer and seek to continuously improve customer satisfaction.
Coordinates the procurement of materials, supplies, services and controls necessary for timely and cost-effective completion of project within budget.
Delegate and manage tasks among team members as appropriate to drive execution of project deliverables and minimize risk.
Document project meeting minutes, issues log, decision log, metrics, and other key communications.
Ensure current Resonetics policies and practices are followed, and accurate documentation requirements are followed.
Identify resources required for project activities, develop project budgets, resource allocations and timelines.
Interact with senior personnel on complex matters requiring coordination between organizations.
Selects process improvement techniques to solve technical problems and makes sound equipment and process recommendations.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree required in engineering or related technical discipline.

Minimum of 8 years of experience leading technical programs. Strong project management experience leading cross functional teams in an operations environment.

Experience managing cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment, with a strong focus on design transfer, manufacturing launches, and line transfer projects across multiple sites.
Proficiency in project management tools ( e.g. MS Project, PowerPoint) and strong analytical skills for problem-solving.
Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with expertise in setting and managing stakeholder expectations.
Strong negotiation and influencing skills, particularly in environments where resources may not be directly controlled.
Solid team leadership, team building and facilitation skills. Ability to facilitate a collaborative working environment for customers and team members.
Solid conflict resolution and arbitration skills.
Strong executive presentation skills, with the ability to regularly engage and present to all levels of the organization, including executive leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in the medical products industry a plus .
Experience with Contract Manufacturing a plus .
Experience with ISO 13485 certified facility expansion and relocation projects preferred.
PMP certification preferred . Advanced certification or degree in project management beneficial.

Physical Demands

Ability and willingness to travel, including internationally . Travel percentage up to 15%.

Compensation

The compensation for this role is competitive and will be based on experience and qualifications. The anticipated range is $96,000.00- $155,000.00.

This position assists in setting the Department of Community Justice (DCJ) digital strategic vision and prioritizing complex technological projects based on that vision. The Department of Community Justice is looking for Project Manager who can demonstrate expertise in the following areas:

Lead the planning and implementation of community justice technological projects, specifically focusing on software development and the adoption of vendor-made hardware solutions (e.g., body scanners and fingerprinting machines); develop master project plans; facilitate scope, goals, milestones, and deliverables; coordinate and lead project staff and project budgets.

Policy Analysis & Compliance

Analyze and review federal, state, and local laws, regulations, policies, and procedures to ensure compliance and formulate recommendations based on best practices, specifically as they pertain to technology in a community supervision environment, including data privacy standards, Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) data security, and related protocols.

Agency Representation & Inquiry Resolution

Respond to and resolve confidential and sensitive inquiries; provide effective relationships and expert guidance to other departments; act as a collaborative representative to department and countywide workgroups and strategic efforts, in addition to standard committees and outreach activities.

Strategic Vision & Executive Advising

Develop effective and collaborative working relationships with DCJ executives to set the digital strategic direction of the agency. Identify and prioritize tech projects across the DCJ divisions to accomplish strategic goals. Advise on organizational structure to support these initiatives, which includes communicating and meeting with the senior management teams of each division. Assist in budget development.

WORKFORCE EQUITY

At Multnomah County we are committed to maintaining an effective, respectful and inclusive workplace. We value collaborative problem solving and strive for continuous improvement. We strongly believe in workforce equity, diversity and inclusion. Visit our Workforce Equity Strategies Plan (WESP) to see where Multnomah County is headed with these values.

DEPARTMENT OF COMMUNITY JUSTICE

Vision ~ Community Safety through Positive Change

The Department of Community Justice (DCJ) is recognized as a national leader in both adult and juvenile community justice. DCJ routinely consults and makes use of evidence-based practices in our program and policy development. The Department's commitment to data-informed decision-making has led DCJ to make smart investments of taxpayer dollars in supervision, sanctions, and services for the county's highest risk and highest need justice-involved individuals. DCJ makes long-term investments in its employees through the provision of education and training. The Department believes that in order to enhance public safety we must work collaboratively with the judiciary, law enforcement, schools, treatment agencies, and the community.

The Department shares information with community members, partners, and staff to keep communities safe by preventing and reducing crime and routinely evaluating which local policies support best practices. DCJ operates 24 hours a day, with nearly 650 regular, on-call, and temporary employees. The Department supervises justice-involved individuals and those defendants requiring pretrial services. DCJ's Juvenile Services Division operates the Donald E. Long Juvenile Detention Facility and is responsible for youth on formal and informal community supervision.

www.multco.us/dcj
.
